text:
Please do not install the 1.1.96 update from the prompt (tap Later). Do the below (take a picture):
1. Settings > Map: off.
2. Set the range to 1.
3. Unplug the radar for 10 seconds and plug it in.
4. Settings > System > Check for update, then Install.

If this does not work, unplug for 10 seconds, plug in, and stay on 1.1.95. We will reach out with a solution.
